title_zh: 约定专注时段试验的比较方法

scenario.label_zh: 安排专注时段试验并选定可靠衡量方法
scenario.goal_zh: 明确不能只凭主观感受判断效率并约定比较完成数量和返工情况

context_zh: 同事 Arlo 与 Nia 筹备一个小组工作方式试验，尚无试验结果。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: I felt more productive when we turned off meeting alerts for an hour.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: That's encouraging, but how will we measure productivity rather than just a feeling?

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Only if the tasks are comparable. A robust comparison should also track work that needs correcting.

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: Let's use the same type of task and record completed items and rework during the trial.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Agreed. We'll review both measures before deciding whether to keep the quiet hour.
